page.overview:
What is Sister Location?

, commonly abbreviated as FNaF: SL and often referred to as Five Nights at Freddy's 5 or FNaF 5, is an independent point-and-click sit-and-survive horror game developed and published by Scottgames, LLC, which released on October 7, 2016, for Windows, as the fifth installment in the Five Nights at Freddy's series. The game was ported to Android on December 22, 2016 and iOS on January 3, 2017.

Scottgames would partner with Clickteam LLC in 2018 to deliver HD, improved "remastered" ports to mobile and consoles. The mobile updates would release on March 20, 2020, for Android and iOS. The port for Nintendo Switch released on June 18, 2020, Xbox on July 9, 2020, and PlayStation on July 22, 2020. These ports/updates fixed bugs, removed copyrighted material, and added subtitles and a cheats menu.

Welcome to Circus Baby's Pizza World, where family fun and interactivity go beyond anything you've seen at those *other* pizza places! With cutting-edge animatronic entertainers that will knock your kids' socks off, as well as customized pizza catering, no party is complete without Circus Baby and the gang!

Now hiring: Late night technician. Must enjoy cramped spaces and be comfortable around active machinery. Not responsible for death or dismemberment.
